parsed.notes:
Experience Required sets required labels; Experience Preferred sets nice_to_have labels.
Technologies and practices named only in Responsibilities are excluded, including EC2, EKS, SageMaker, and infrastructure-as-code.
Production infrastructure is interpreted as AI infrastructure in the explicit ML-systems context; this mapping is flagged for review.
Inference systems map to model-serving. General model optimization is left unmapped rather than narrowed to inference optimization.
The preferred MLOps platforms, feature stores, or ML observability solutions are alternatives, but MLOps is independently required and feature stores has no taxonomy ID, leaving no two mapped skills eligible for an alternative_group.
Degree subject names are not independently treated as requested technical skills.
